title: Climate-Driven Supply-Demand Matching Reshapes Global SolarEV Decarbonization Potential
abstract: arXiv:2610.29344v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rooftop photovoltaics (PV) can support rapid urban decarbonization, but their contribution is constrained by the imbalance between PV generation and demand, both shaped by local climate. Growing urban electric-vehicle (EV) deployment creates distributed storage near rooftop PV, shifting PV electricity across time. Here we simulate rooftop PV integrated with EVs as batteries across 5,000 grid cells globally, using hourly meteorology and climate-induced demand. We find that PV-EV systems can supply up to 84% of annual building and mobility electricity demand. Self-sufficiency is highest where daytime demand aligns with generation and seasonal variability remains limited. Using PV capacity factor alone to screen PV-EV potential undervalues 21.9% of the world's 1,000 most populous cities because generation-side metrics overlook the temporal coupling of PV generation, electricity demand and EV storage. translated_title: 气候驱动的供需匹配重塑全球光伏-电动汽车脱碳潜力
translated_abstract: 屋顶光伏（PV）能够支持城市的快速脱碳，但其贡献受到光伏发电与电力需求之间不平衡的制约，而这两者均受当地气候的影响。城市电动汽车（EV）的日益普及在屋顶光伏附近形成了分布式储能，可以在时间上转移光伏电力。本研究在全球5000个网格单元上模拟了屋顶光伏与作为电池使用的电动汽车的集成，采用逐小时气象数据以及受气候影响的需求。研究发现，光伏-电动汽车系统可以满足高达84%的年度建筑与交通电力需求。当白天需求与发电时段相吻合且季节波动有限时，系统自给自足率最高。若仅使用光伏容量因子来筛选光伏-电动汽车潜力，将会低估全球1000个人口最多城市中21.9%的潜力，因为发电侧指标忽视了光伏发电、电力需求与电动汽车储能之间的时间耦合。巨大的光伏-电动汽车潜力主要集中在……
tldr: 该研究通过全球5000个网格的逐小时模拟发现，屋顶光伏与电动汽车分布式储能结合可满足高达84%的建筑与交通用电需求，且仅用光伏容量因子筛选会因忽视发电、需求与储能间的时间耦合而低估全球21.9%的人口最多城市的脱碳潜力。
en_tdlr: Simulating rooftop PV integrated with EV storage across 5,000 global grid cells, this study shows PV-EV systems can meet up to 84% of annual building and mobility electricity demand, and that screening by PV capacity factor alone undervalues 21.9% of the world's 1,000 most populous cities due to overlooked temporal coupling of generation, demand, and EV storage.
